name: Daily, correct, robust ETL from the data vendors to the Portal (49F + Inflection anchor; all Opal partners)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-02. Drive to CLEAN, VALIDATED pipelines for 49 Financial + Inflection ETL + PREDICTABLE, ROBUST Portal data refresh from those pipelines. End-state (Andrew, sharpened): DAILY, CORRECT ETL from the data VENDORS (Orion / Black Diamond / Schwab) down to the PORTAL, for ALL Opal partners (49F + Inflection are the anchor cases; the durable patterns generalize). A coordinating + HARDENING umbrella that turns the current reactive firefight (recurring served-AUA freezes: inf @06-30, bd-49F @06-29, MDPF @06-25) into a standing, monitored, validated, robust ETL by closing 5 systemic fragility classes: (1) fail-CATASTROPHIC converters (a single dim's vendor-pull miss aborts the whole nightly -- the inf INF_API_SILVER_TXN abort); (2) fail-SILENT degrades (a crash-fix that trades a loud-freeze for a silent-stale, no alarm); (3) vendor-source BRITTLENESS (Orion txn timeout, BD MFA scrape-break, Schwab ingest stall); (4) UNPREDICTABLE refresh + no uniform per-partner freshness SLA; (5) NON-UNIFORM validation (parity/never-widen/single-writer/no-clobber enforced heroically per-incident, not as a daily gate). 4 binding end-state properties: DAILY + CORRECT + VENDOR->PORTAL + ALL-PARTNERS. Base CTO/COO/CVO are ETL-DEDICATED per Andrew (the ~B fork takes a separate track). PRD docs/architecture/ADVI_ETLFIX_PRD.md.

prds.label: ADVI_ETLFIX PRD v1.0 (CTO-authored; coordinating+hardening umbrella, 5 workstreams)

(B) 49F/Black-Diamond -- source frozen @06-29 (SS&C MFA); 0.6.0 live-cookie backfill + 0.7.0~A durable REST auth-migration (ADVI_BDAPIMIG). (C) 49F/Schwab+MDPF -- custody flip bd->schwab-native FIRED (0.5.0, 12dd979c7, SSM schwab v2 @14:06Z, clears 06-25 freeze, rollback armed), CVO post-flip per-field parity pending (CTO never-widen caveat); Schwab raw ingest (0.6.2 canonical-schwab-si2) + the daily-box repoint brief (368c3ad0b, 4 CTO arch-decisions) is now LOAD-BEARING for MDPF custody. Phases 1-N = the durable hardening (WS-1..5): robustness contract + per-partner freshness SLA-as-gate + uniform correctness gates + all-partners generalization.
blocking: COO TO decomposition + GO (the 9 named agents -> WS-1..5). Phase-0 un-freeze is 0.6.1's fixable critical path (clears today). Leash (every TO): degrade LOUD not catastrophic not silent; never-widen + single-writer + parity + no-clobber; ground on served/deployed not self-report (Rule 22); freshness SLA is a GATE; firm-separation (49F/inf/cot never cross); don't over-build a sunset source (BD bridge-vs-SSOTMG decision D); no ad-hoc gold runs to validate.

depends_on_note: A coordinating+hardening umbrella (the DATA_SSOTMG thin-coordinating pattern) -- COORDINATES + hardens the SEAMS + the cross-cutting properties (robustness / freshness-SLA / validation) across the sibling execution projects; does NOT re-own their content.
